propositions: 108 store tickets carry criteria under '## Success Criteria' as plain bullets, which are invisible to the AC item counter and cannot carry operator attestation tags
Criteria must be migrated to '## Acceptance Criteria' as '- [ ]' checkbox items so they are counted and individually checkable
A migration script must rewrite tickets via rebar.edit_ticket with --dry-run as default to avoid silently invalidating in-flight plan-review attestations
The migration must handle all section-ordering cases (SC-first, AC-first, both existing, SC-only, qualified headings) without duplication or data loss
Post-migration verification must confirm zero remaining '## Success Criteria' headings and all 106 migrated tickets meet the AC floor (_count_ac_items >= 1)
